title: Earliest Skinwalker UFO images kept with full metadata
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Earliest Skinwalker UFO images kept with full metadata, about 2016-2020s at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: even the earliest UFO images that were captured above Skinwalker Ranch under my stewardship, I have the metadata.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, says that since he took over in 2016 his team has photographed UFOs above it. He says that even for the earliest of these images he still has the metadata, the hidden data that records when and how a photo was taken, which he offers as a way to show they are genuine.
